channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Twin Cities suburb fights over personal freedom — to choose a trash hauler
item.description: Voters in Anoka rejected moving to organized garbage collection. But now the city could recycle the issue that has stirred debate across the region.

item.title: When the news is too much, find solace in these 10 local spaces
item.description: Music, art, nature, beauty all showcase why we live in the Twin Cities.

item.title: UCare CEO salary topped $1M as the health insurer foundered
item.description: Compensation for Hilary Marden-Resnik declined, but still stood out given insurer’s failure. The CEO is stepping down with the Jan. 1 sale of UCare assets to a competitor.

item.title: Behind Tim Walz’s decision to drop out of the governor’s race
item.description: Walz reversed course on his re-election amid a barrage of unfavorable headlines, threats to his family and skepticism from fellow Democrats. But his private doubts about running began earlier.

item.title: How a 40-second encounter led an ICE agent to shoot and kill a Twin Cities resident
item.description: What eyewitness evidence, video recordings and message logs tell us about the shooting death of Renee Nicole Good by ICE agent Jonathan Ross.

item.title: In Minnesota’s most conservative county, GOP governor hopefuls weigh in on ICE shooting, criticize Walz
item.description: Ten Republican candidates set the table for this year’s election with a focus on fraud.

item.title: Law enforcement hopes to obtain devices to catch people driving high
item.description: Devices that could determine if someone was impaired by a substance other than alcohol were “highly accurate,” during a pilot, a Public Safety Department spokesman said.

item.title: Takeaways: Timberwolves figure out how to take on Victor Wembanyama at the end in 104-103 victory over Spurs
item.description: Anthony Edwards hit the go-ahead basket with 16.8 seconds left and the Wolves won after trailing by as many as 19 points.

item.title: Noem says more immigration agents heading to Minnesota in wake of fatal shooting
item.description: Homeland Security Secretary says additional immigration officers needed so the operation can continue safely.

item.title: Minnesota’s Sun Country Airlines to be acquired by Allegiant in $1.5B deal
item.description: The companies say deal will combine route networks to offer Minneapolis-St. Paul International Airport to more mid-sized markets and vacation destinations.
